ev.q: In the 2016–17 season, the percentage of cases in children aged <5 years declined to 78%
the percentage of positive test results by PCR increased 152%
the percentage of reported PCR detections in patients aged ≥65 years was higher
as part of the state’s passive infectious disease surveillance
the percentage of cases in persons aged ≥65 years increased in each successive season

methods_quotes.q: All analyses were performed using SAS software (version 9.4, SAS Institute).
Reported laboratory tests were categorized as rapid antigen, PCR, or other (i.e., culture or immunofluorescence assays).
